description: Ministry of Megapolis & Western Development - Rectification notice on Gaz. Ex. No. 1396/7 of 07.06.2005
reasoning: This gazette notification primarily deals with land use planning and zoning regulations for Kalutara, specifically rectifying floor area limits for Primary Residential and Mixed Residential zones. It involves land development regulations and property-related matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) rather than government personnel or structural changes.
